title: Consistent reviewers
statementMd:
List reviewers whose lowest rating is at least 7 and who wrote at least three reviews.

Expected columns: `reviewer`, `reviews`, `lowest`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT reviewer, COUNT(*) AS reviews, MIN(rating) AS lowest FROM reviews GROUP BY reviewer HAVING MIN(rating) >= 7 AND COUNT(*) >= 3;
```
